_readme: Product marketing framework (owner, 18 Nov 2026). One file per launch. Matrix 1: what matters most to each user type across ten benefit fields (w: 3 matters most, 2 matters, 1 nice to have) and the claim that resonates. Matrix 2: Series II against Series I. Matrix 3: against Infratech (competitor rule: factual, sourced, needs_approval Specification and compliance). Claims carry no new facts: every fact is in `facts` with its source.
name: Tungsten Smart-Heat® Electric Series II

launch.summary: Select and Coastal launched October 2026; Classic follows in January 2027 as Series I sells through. Cobalt is discontinued.

phases.what: Series II Select (Better) and Coastal (Best) launch; Series I moves to entry level; Cobalt discontinued
Series II Classic (Good) launches; Series I discontinued

tiers.name: Tungsten Classic
notes: 2 and 3 kW added to the existing 4 and 6 kW; same voltage options
Black body, stainless steel end covers and metal face guard

tiers.name: Tungsten Select
tiers.colours: Black, white and graphite (graphite on 4 and 6 kW)
tiers.fascia: Diamond Pattern standard; oval and star patterns sold separately

tiers.name: Tungsten Coastal
notes: 316 marine-grade stainless steel for coastal environments
4 and 6 kW only, same voltage options

upgrades: Low-clearance recess kit (Select and Coastal): fits shallow ceilings and tight soffits
Slimmer body: 140 mm (5.5 in) deep and 183 mm (7.2 in) wide, against 156 mm (6.1 in) and 214 mm (8.4 in) for Series I
New accessories: wall-mounting bracket, pitched-ceiling adaptor (3/12 to 12/12), bracket with set positions at 15°, 30° and 45°
price_verify: [[VERIFY: launch list prices by model and region — Sales operations]]

user_types.name: Homeowners
user_types.who: Residential end consumers warming a patio, deck, alfresco or pool house

user_types.name: Builders
user_types.who: Production, semi-custom and custom home builders and remodelers

user_types.name: Installers
user_types.who: Electrical contractors and installers who fit and wire the heaters

user_types.name: Commercial and corporate users
user_types.who: Restaurants, hotels, bars, workplaces and venues that run heated outdoor space

user_types.name: Architects
user_types.who: Architects and specifiers who write the heater into the drawings

user_types.name: Designers
user_types.who: Interior, landscape and outdoor-living designers who choose how the space looks

benefits.name: Heat performance
benefits.what: Output from 2 to 6 kW, precise directional infrared warmth and coverage

benefits.name: Installation flexibility
benefits.what: Wall, ceiling, single post, pitched ceilings and set angles

benefits.name: Ease of installation
benefits.what: Familiar mounting, one kit across the range, quick to fit and quote

benefits.name: Recess ability
benefits.what: Flush in ceilings and soffits, now including shallow cavities

benefits.name: Safety and peace of mind
benefits.what: Electric infrared with no flame or fumes, listed hardware, set mounting heights

benefits.name: Design aesthetics
benefits.what: Slimmer body, colours and fascia patterns

benefits.name: Design flexibility
benefits.what: Interchangeable fascias, colours, tiers and mounts to suit the design

benefits.name: Ease of controls
benefits.what: Affinity Smart-Heat® Controls: dimming, app, schedules, zones, wall switch

benefits.name: Heat multiple outdoor areas
benefits.what: Zones, outputs and mounts to warm several spaces from one family

benefits.name: Durability by the coast
benefits.what: Materials and finishes for salt air and rain

benefits.name: Specification and support
benefits.what: Design service, documentation and partner support

heat.claim: Up to 6 kW from dual elements, dimmed to suit the evening with the Affinity Smart-Heat® Dimmer.

install_flex.claim: Ceiling, wall, a slim single post or a pitched roof: there is a way to fit warmth to your space.

install_ease.claim: Goes up quickly on mounts your electrician already knows.

recess.claim: Full 6 kW warmth, flush in a shallow ceiling and dual fan-ventilated.

safety.claim: Vented recessing, no flame, no fumes, and app timers that switch the heat off for you: peace of mind all evening.

aesthetics.claim: About 14% slimmer, all black, all white or all graphite, floating on a single post with no visible junction box: beautiful against a timber ceiling.

design_flex.claim: Choose the fascia, the colour and the mount that suit your home, and change the look later with a new fascia.

controls.claim: Turn the warmth up, down or onto a schedule from your phone with Affinity Smart-Heat® Controls.

warranty.claim: Backed by Bromic's manufacturer warranty, so the evenings outside are worry-free.

multi_area.claim: The right Bromic heater for the garage, the pergola, the California room, the open terrace and the lounge, all on one app.

coastal.claim: By the sea, Tungsten Coastal protects twice over: 316 marine-grade stainless steel and a protective coating.

support.claim: A complimentary design plan shows where every heater belongs before anything is fixed.

heat.claim: 2 to 6 kW in one family: size each plan from 65 ft² up (Series I published coverage) with a free design plan.

install_flex.claim: Pitched porches from 3/12 to 12/12, extended wall brackets for deep eaves, a single post for pergolas, and recessing in a 7.5 in cavity.

install_ease.claim: No ceiling box to frame and line, and one post instead of two: recessed or suspended, quick to quote and quick to fit.

recess.claim: 6 kW recessed in a 7.5 in cavity, dual fan-ventilated, with no site-built fire-rated box: alfresco and soffit plans won without re-framing.

safety.claim: All-electric heat with no gas line, flame or fumes, and a dual fan-ventilated recess.

aesthetics.claim: A body about 14% narrower and 10% shallower than Series I, floating on a single post with no junction box in sight.

design_flex.claim: Black, white or graphite and three fascias to match each elevation and colour scheme.

controls.claim: Affinity Smart-Heat® Dimmer and app: a smart upgrade buyers see at the design centre.

warranty.claim: Series I cover is 2 years on the heater and 7 on the elements, and partners add a year on qualifying products.

multi_area.claim: One supplier for every outdoor room on the plan: Classic, Select, Coastal, Platinum and freestanding.

coastal.claim: Coastal developments get 316 stainless plus a protective coating as standard, not an upgrade.

support.claim: Partner pricing, free design plans, a dedicated contact and project spotlights through the Bromic Partner Program.

heat.claim: 2, 3, 4 and 6 kW; the 4 and 6 kW models carry two separately wired elements, so one heater runs at part or full output.

install_flex.claim: Ceiling; pitched ceilings from 3/12 (14°) to 12/12 (45°) with the adaptor; standard or extended wall bracket; bracket presets at 15°, 30° and 45°, re-angled later; single post; recessed in a 7.5 in cavity.

install_ease.claim: One post instead of Series I's two suspension tubes, no recess box to build, no visible junction box, and Classic keeps Series I mounting.

recess.claim: Recess 6 kW into a 7.5 in cavity with the dual fan-ventilated low-clearance kit; no site-built box; a marine-grade kit for Coastal.

safety.claim: Minimum mounting heights of 72 in on a wall and 96 in on a ceiling (Series I), a dual fan-ventilated recess, and app timers for the client.

aesthetics.claim: A body about 14% narrower and 10% shallower than Series I (183 × 140 mm), with no junction box on show.

design_flex.claim: Fascias change without re-wiring or re-mounting: Diamond standard, oval and star optional.

controls.claim: Wire both elements of the 4 and 6 kW models to an Affinity Smart-Heat® Dimmer: 6 kW per channel at 208–277 V.

warranty.claim: Series I: 2 years on the heater and 7 years on the elements, plus a partner year on qualifying products; one technical line, 1-800-301-1293.

multi_area.claim: Affinity controllers in 1, 2 or 5 channels: zone each area and commission it in one visit.

coastal.claim: Coastal jobs: 316 marine-grade stainless with a protective coating, and a marine-grade low-clearance recess kit.

support.claim: Installation manuals, CAD files, a technical line and a dedicated Partner Program contact.

heat.claim: Up to 6 kW per heater from dual elements, dimmed zone by zone to the night and the crowd.

install_flex.claim: Post, wall, ceiling or recess, so every terrace, rooftop and courtyard can be heated.

install_ease.claim: Familiar mounting keeps fit-out days short.

recess.claim: 6 kW flush in a 7.5 in cavity, dual fan-ventilated, with no fire-rated box to build: full commercial heat in shallow canopies.

safety.claim: Vented recessing, no flame or cylinders, and timers that keep heat to service hours.

aesthetics.claim: A body about 14% narrower and 10% shallower than before: a refined, low-profile line that suits the venue.

design_flex.claim: Match the heater to each space, from the bar terrace to the private dining deck.

controls.claim: Zones and schedules through Affinity Smart-Heat® Controls, with building-system integration where you need it.

warranty.claim: A manufacturer warranty on every heater, with support from a single partner.

multi_area.claim: From the bar terrace to the lounge and the open courtyard, one Bromic family and one app.

coastal.claim: Waterfront venues get double corrosion protection: 316 marine-grade stainless plus a protective coating.

support.claim: A complimentary design plan maps heat to every table before you commit.

heat.claim: 2, 3, 4 and 6 kW, dual elements on 4 and 6 kW for stepped output; zones laid out by Bromic's design plan.

install_flex.claim: Detail flat or pitched ceilings (3/12 to 12/12), walls with standard or extended brackets, angles at 15°, 30° and 45°, single posts and recesses.

install_ease.claim: A recess detail with no site-built box and a single-post detail with one fixing point.

recess.claim: Specify 6 kW flush in a 7.5 in cavity with a dual fan-ventilated low-clearance kit and no site-built fire-rated enclosure.

safety.claim: Write in minimum mounting heights (72 in wall, 96 in ceiling for Series I), listed hardware and a dual fan-ventilated recess.

aesthetics.claim: A full-body black, white or graphite finish and a 183 × 140 mm section, about 23% smaller than Series I, on a single post with no visible junction box.

design_flex.claim: Three colours and three fascias from one specification family across every mounting condition.

controls.claim: Affinity Smart-Heat® Controls with Ethernet and 0–10 V through the expansion board for BMS and home automation.

warranty.claim: Series I: 2 years on the heater, 7 years on the elements.

multi_area.claim: One specification family for terraces, balconies, pergolas and courtyards.

coastal.claim: Specify 316 marine-grade stainless with a protective coating, and a marine-grade recess kit, for coastal sites.

support.claim: CAD and Revit files, AIA-accredited courses and a complimentary design plan.

heat.claim: Warmth placed exactly where people gather, with outputs from 2 to 6 kW.

install_flex.claim: A slim single post and pitched-ceiling options let heat follow the design, not the other way round.

install_ease.claim: Simple to install, so the design survives the build.

recess.claim: Flush, low-clearance recessing for the clean ceiling plane a considered outdoor room deserves.

safety.claim: Warmth without flame or fumes beside soft furnishings and planting.

aesthetics.claim: All black, all white or all graphite, a 23% smaller section and a Diamond, oval or star fascia, floating on a single post: made to sit against timber ceilings.

design_flex.claim: Swap fascias and choose colours to suit each room, and refresh the look without changing the heater.

controls.claim: Dim the warmth with the mood of the evening through Affinity Smart-Heat® Controls.

warranty.claim: A manufacturer warranty behind every piece you specify.

multi_area.claim: A heater designed for each room: Platinum for the California room, Eclipse for the lounge, Tungsten for the pergola.

coastal.claim: Coastal finishes that keep their looks by the sea.

support.claim: A design plan and product files to bring the concept to life.

m2.s1: 2000, 3000, 4000 and 6000 W; coverage published as 65, 100, 130 and 160 ft² (product page; the manual says up to 64, 100, 120 and 144 ft²). Quartz-sheathed steel coil element; 4000 and 6000 W have two elements.
m2.s2: Same four power levels on Select (2–6 kW); Classic adds 2 and 3 kW to its 4 and 6 kW; Coastal is 4 and 6 kW. Dual elements on 4 and 6 kW, dimmable with the Affinity Smart-Heat® Dimmer. [[VERIFY: Series II coverage per model — Product team]]
m2.so_what: The warmth customers trust carries straight over: the story is design and fit, with no trade-off in heat.

m2.s1: Wall (straight or 30°), ceiling, chain or 3 ft tube suspension, and recessed.
m2.s2: Ceiling, pitched ceiling (adaptor for 3/12 to 12/12), wall and extended wall bracket, single post, angle adjustable up to 45° and re-angled later, and low-clearance recessing with 7.5 in clearance.
m2.so_what: Vaulted porches, gables and angled walls are now standard details rather than custom work.

m2.s1: Tube suspension uses two suspension tubes (sold separately); recessing needs an installer-built ceiling box in Hardie or cement board.
m2.s2: A single post replaces the two suspension tubes; recessing needs no box built on site, because the low-clearance kit is the recess; one kit serves Select and Coastal; Classic keeps Series I mounting.
m2.so_what: No box to build and fewer fixings: recessed and suspended installs become quick, one-trade jobs.

m2.s1: Standard recess kit only, which needs a deep ceiling cavity (Bromic guidance: at least 20 in, with two layers of 5/8 in fireproof insulation). No low-clearance option for Tungsten.
m2.s2: Dual fan-ventilated low-clearance recess kit, needing a 7.5 in cavity, for Select; a marine-grade version for Coastal. Classic uses the existing recess kit.
m2.so_what: Safe, vented 6 kW flush heat in shallow ceilings with no box to build: the only 6 kW recessed outdoor heater with a dual fan-ventilated, low-clearance recess kit and no site-built fire-rated box.

m2.s1: Intertek ETL/cETL listed; IPX4; minimum mounting 72 in on a wall and 96 in on a ceiling (96 in in all cases in Canada); designed for intermittent use.
m2.s2: Electric infrared with no flame or fumes; the low-clearance recess is dual fan-ventilated; app timers and schedules through Affinity Smart-Heat® Controls. [[VERIFY: Series II listing, IP rating and minimum mounting heights — Product team]]
m2.so_what: Peace of mind is unchanged; confirm the Series II listings before launch claims use them.

m2.s1: Honeycomb mesh fascia; 2000/3000 W in black, 4000/6000 W in black or white. Body about 214 mm (8.4 in) wide and 156 mm (6.1 in) deep (launch deck).
m2.s2: Slimmer: about 183 mm (7.2 in) wide and 140 mm (5.5 in) deep, about 14% narrower and 10% shallower, a section about 23% smaller; on a single post it appears to float with no visible junction box. Diamond Pattern standard on Select and Coastal; Classic in a stylised wireframe with stainless end covers. Section = width × depth: 33,384 mm² to 25,620 mm². [[VERIFY: Series I dimensions differ between the deck (214 × 156 mm) and the manual (8.5 × 3.5 in) — Product team]]
m2.so_what: A visibly slimmer, more designed heater: the reason to choose Series II at first glance.

m2.s1: One fascia design; two colours on the larger models.
m2.s2: Three fascia options on Select (Diamond Pattern standard; traditional oval and star sold separately); black, white and graphite (graphite on 4 and 6 kW). Three tiers: Classic, Select, Coastal.
m2.so_what: Designers can match the heater to the room and change the look later, without changing the heater.

m2.s1: Affinity Smart-Heat® On/Off and Dimmer controllers and the manual wall switch; the two elements on 4000/6000 W can be switched separately.
m2.s2: Same Affinity Smart-Heat® Controls, with the Affinity Dimmer as the recommended controller for the dual-element 4 and 6 kW models; app timers and schedules.
m2.so_what: Nothing new to learn for installers or homeowners: the same app, dimmer and wall switch.

m2.s1: 2 years on the heater, 7 years on the elements; replacement heater or part, owner pays labour and shipping.
m2.s2: [[VERIFY: Series II warranty terms, including Coastal — Product team]] Partners receive an additional year on qualifying products.
m2.so_what: Confirm whether Coastal's marine-grade build earns longer cover: it would be a strong launch message.

m2.s1: Four outputs and mounts for most covered spaces.
m2.s2: Classic for the garage, Select on the pergola and Coastal by the water, alongside Platinum for the California room, Tungsten Freestanding Gas for open seating and Eclipse Freestanding for lounging, all on the Bromic app. [[VERIFY: app control for the freestanding heaters — Product team]]
m2.so_what: One brand and one app for every outdoor room of the home.

m2.s1: Not rated for marine use: Bromic advises mounting under cover, away from rain, snow and salt mist; stainless grade not published.
m2.s2: Tungsten Coastal: 316 marine-grade stainless steel with a protective coating (dual corrosion protection), and a marine-grade low-clearance recess kit. [[VERIFY: name and specification of the Coastal coating — Product team]]
m2.so_what: Tungsten can now be sold to coastal homes and waterfront venues, a market Series I could not serve.

m2.s1: Installation manual, cut sheet, design service and technical support.
m2.s2: The same support, plus new launch literature, photography and training. [[VERIFY: Series II manuals, CAD and Revit files at launch — Product team]]
m2.so_what: Make sure trade files are live on launch day: specifiers will look for them first.

rows.infratech: 1.5 to 6 kW in single and dual element models; the manual gives about 11 ft × 11 ft average coverage for the 6,000 W dual-element model at 8–12 ft.
rows.bromic: Parity in output: 2 to 6 kW, with dual elements on the 4 and 6 kW models dimmable through the Affinity Smart-Heat® Dimmer. Compete on how the heat is controlled and installed, not on wattage.

RES.claim: Lead with the warmth people feel at the table, not a coverage race.

BLD.claim: Match output to plan size from 2 to 6 kW in one family.

INS.claim: Equivalent outputs; size on Bromic's published coverage and the design plan.

COM.claim: Let the free design plan prove coverage seat by seat.

ARC.claim: Specify by the design plan, model by model.

DES.claim: Talk about where the warmth lands, not the wattage.

rows.infratech: Wall, ceiling, flush, pole and drop pole; the flush frame "is ONLY to be used on a flat non-sloped ceiling" and "cannot be installed on a pitched angle".
rows.bromic: Ceiling, pitched ceiling (3/12 to 12/12), wall and extended wall, single post, angle adjustable up to 45° and changeable later, and low-clearance recessing.

RES.claim: Vaulted porch or gable? Tungsten mounts neatly to a pitched ceiling with a dedicated adaptor.

BLD.claim: Pitched-ceiling adaptor and single post handle the porches and gables in your plans.

INS.claim: Preset 15°, 30° and 45° positions and a pitched-ceiling adaptor take the guesswork out of angled mounts.

COM.claim: A slim single post suits canopies and pergolas where ceilings are not flat.

ARC.claim: Detail heaters on pitched ceilings and posts with standard Bromic hardware.

DES.claim: Heat follows the architecture, flat ceiling or not.

rows.infratech: Flush frames need a framed pocket of at least 2×8, lined and sealed on all five sides; the junction box must be mounted outside the sealed pocket. [[VERIFY: Infratech pole mounts use two posts — Specification and compliance]]
rows.bromic: One post instead of two; recessing needs no box built on site, because the low-clearance kit is the recess; one kit across Select and Coastal.

RES.claim: No box to build in your ceiling: a tidier, faster recessed install.

BLD.claim: No framed, lined pocket to build: the kit is the recess.

INS.claim: No box, no five-sided lining: fit the kit and the heater, and move on.

COM.claim: Recessed heat without extra trades on site.

ARC.claim: A simpler recess detail with no site-built box.

DES.claim: Flush heat without the building work.

rows.infratech: W/WD models flush-mount in a framed pocket: minimum 2×8 framing, lined and sealed on five sides with 5/8 in Type X drywall, flat ceilings only, junction box outside the pocket, no fans; a 15-minute cool-down is recommended after 4 hours of continuous use. No low-clearance kit; Motif fascias cannot be recessed.
rows.bromic: Tungsten Series II is the only 6 kW recessed outdoor heater with a dual fan-ventilated, low-clearance recess kit and no site-built fire-rated box: dual fan-ventilated, a 7.5 in cavity, a marine-grade version for Coastal. It is not the shallowest: lead with the venting and the box-free install, never with "only" or depth alone. [[VERIFY: that the low-clearance kit needs no fire-rated lining or enclosure under its listing, and that 7.5 in is the cavity depth — Product team; competitor check signed off — Specification and compliance]]

RES.claim: Flush and dual fan-ventilated, so you can enjoy the whole evening without a cool-down.

BLD.claim: No framed, five-sided fire-rated pocket to build: the kit is the recess.

INS.claim: Dual fan ventilation manages the heat in the cavity: a simpler, safer recess.

COM.claim: 6 kW, flush, dual fan-ventilated, with no fire-rated box to build and no cool-down advice.

ARC.claim: The only dual fan-ventilated 6 kW recess kit found, with no site-built fire-rated box to detail.

DES.claim: A clean, flush ceiling, safely ventilated.

rows.infratech: Flush-frame drawing: "After 4 hours of continuous use, a 15 minute cool down period is recommended for maximum heater longevity. See controls brochure for timer options." App control needs Bond smart switches bundled with a separate Universal Control Panel.
rows.bromic: The low-clearance recess kit is dual fan-ventilated for extended evenings of use; the Bromic app switches heaters off remotely, runs timers and sets a night-time shut-off from anywhere. [[VERIFY: low-clearance kit rated for continuous use, with no cool-down guidance — Product team]]

RES.claim: Enjoy the whole evening: the recess is dual fan-ventilated, and the app can switch the heat off from anywhere or at a set time each night.

BLD.claim: Peace of mind buyers can see: dual fan-ventilated recessing, app timers and remote shut-off.

INS.claim: Dual fan-ventilated recess for extended use; set timers and a nightly shut-off in the app at handover.

COM.claim: Heat through the whole service with no cool-down break, and a scheduled shut-off at close.

ARC.claim: Specify a dual fan-ventilated recess for extended use, with timer and remote shut-off through Affinity controls.

DES.claim: Warmth that stays on all evening and switches itself off at night.

rows.infratech: In every colour option the colour sits on the end caps, while the polished stainless reflector and open wire guard stay the same (Infratech colour images, C/CD Series); the junction box sits on top of the heater.
rows.bromic: Fully monochrome finishes: all black, all white or all graphite, which sit naturally against timber ceilings; a Diamond, oval or star fascia over the elements; about 14% slimmer than Series I; floats on a single post with no visible junction box.

RES.claim: All black, all white or all graphite: the whole heater in one finish, beautiful against a timber ceiling.

BLD.claim: Monochrome heaters that disappear into timber soffits on the model home.

INS.claim: One finish from end to end, a single post and no junction box to hide.

COM.claim: A single-colour heater that matches the venue's ceiling, not a stainless bar with coloured ends.

ARC.claim: Specify a fully monochrome heater, black, white or graphite, with a patterned fascia and a 23% smaller section.

DES.claim: All black, all white or all graphite, with a Diamond, oval or star fascia: designed to sit within timber and plaster ceilings.

rows.infratech: Brushed stainless or eight end-cap colours plus custom; Motif decorative fascias fit C/CD surface-mount models only and cannot be used flush.
rows.bromic: Three full-body finishes (black, white, graphite) and three fascias (Diamond standard, oval and star) across ceiling, wall, post and recessed installs. [[VERIFY: fascias available on recessed installs — Product team]]

RES.claim: Choose the finish for the whole heater and the pattern of its fascia, and change the fascia later.

BLD.claim: Three finishes and three fascias to suit every elevation.

INS.claim: Swap fascias without re-wiring or re-mounting.

COM.claim: Coordinate finish and fascia with each space of the venue.

ARC.claim: Patterned fascias specified across mounting conditions, including recessed.

DES.claim: Finish and pattern chosen together, for a heater that reads as part of the design.

rows.infratech: Switches, timers and panels; Wi-Fi and app control through Bond-powered smart switches, bundled with the Universal Control Panel; integration with Lutron, Crestron, Control4 and Savant.
rows.bromic: Affinity Smart-Heat® Dimmer for dual-element heat up to 6 kW, app timers, schedules and zones from the controller, Alexa and Google Assistant, and Control4, Crestron or Lutron (compatibility varies); Wi-Fi and app features need compatible Affinity controls, sold separately.

RES.claim: One Bromic app for warmth, schedules and zones, designed with the heater.

BLD.claim: A smart upgrade from one brand, not a third-party add-on.

INS.claim: Commission heater and controls from one manufacturer in one visit.

COM.claim: Zones and schedules from one system, with building integration where needed.

ARC.claim: One manufacturer for heater and control, with BMS and home-automation options.

DES.claim: Dimmable warmth from a single, elegant control system.

rows.infratech: 3 years against defects for the original purchaser at the original site; elite dealers may add a fourth year; competitor controls may void cover; element rated to 5,000 hours.
rows.bromic: Tungsten (Series I): 2 years on the heater and 7 years on the elements; partners receive an additional year on qualifying products. [[VERIFY: Series II warranty, including Coastal — Product team]]

RES.claim: Seven years of cover on the heating elements.

BLD.claim: Partner warranty extension on qualifying products.

INS.claim: One manufacturer stands behind heater and controls.

COM.claim: Long element cover protects the part that works hardest.

ARC.claim: Element cover the client can count on.

DES.claim: Cover that matches the life of the design.

rows.infratech: Fixed-mount electric infrared heaters only (C/CD, W/WD, SL, Motif fascias and a garage heater); no freestanding, gas or pendant heaters on infratech.com.
rows.bromic: A portfolio for every use: electric heaters for ceilings, walls, posts and recesses (Tungsten Classic, Select and Coastal; Platinum), the Eclipse pendant with heat and light, Eclipse Freestanding electric, built-in gas heaters, and Tungsten Freestanding Gas, controlled through the Bromic app where Affinity-compatible. [[VERIFY: app control for the freestanding heaters — Product team]]

RES.claim: Garage, pergola, California room, open terrace and lounge: a Bromic heater designed for each, electric or gas, mounted or freestanding.

BLD.claim: Every outdoor space on the plan from one brand: mounted, recessed, pendant, freestanding, electric and gas.

INS.claim: One manufacturer for electric and gas, mounted and freestanding, on every job.

COM.claim: Mounted heat for canopies, freestanding warmth for open terraces, gas where there is no power: one supplier.

ARC.claim: One specification family across every condition, from recessed soffits to open terraces with no wall or ceiling.

DES.claim: A heater designed for each room, from the Eclipse pendant to freestanding warmth by the sofa.

rows.infratech: 316 stainless offered as a Marine UpGrade option on C, CD, W and WD models; the manual notes 316 is "stainless, not stain-free" and asks for frequent fresh-water cleaning near salt; flush frames listed in 304 stainless.
rows.bromic: Tungsten Coastal: dual corrosion protection, 316 marine-grade stainless steel plus a protective coating, as standard, with a marine-grade low-clearance recess kit. [[VERIFY: name and specification of the Coastal coating — Product team]]

RES.claim: Double protection by the sea: 316 marine-grade stainless plus a protective coating.

BLD.claim: Coastal developments get double corrosion protection as standard, not as an upgrade.

INS.claim: Marine-grade heater, protective coating and marine-grade recess kit for every coastal job.

COM.claim: Double corrosion protection for waterfront venues, recessed or surface-mounted.

ARC.claim: Specify dual corrosion protection and a marine-grade recess as one system.

DES.claim: Coastal finishes protected twice over, so they keep their looks by the sea.

rows.infratech: Trade program with design guides, CAD details and continuing-education credits; elite dealers get leads and training.
rows.bromic: Bromic Partner Program: partner pricing, free custom heating design plans, extended warranty, a dedicated point of contact and project marketing spotlights; CAD and Revit files and AIA-accredited courses.

RES.claim: A free design plan shows where every heater goes.

BLD.claim: Partner pricing, design plans and a dedicated contact.

INS.claim: A dedicated contact and technical line behind every job.

COM.claim: A design plan mapped to every table before you commit.

ARC.claim: Revit files, AIA courses and design plans on request.

DES.claim: Project spotlights that showcase your work.

W/WD Series installation manual (2015, dealer-hosted): flush frames for 33, 39 and 61¼ in heaters

EF Series dual element heater installation manual (2024): flush mount, 2×8 studs minimum, fire-rated pocket

C/CD Series colour options (colour images: colour on end caps, stainless reflector and wire guard in every finish); product range menu

pillars.title: Up To 6 kW, Dimmed To The Evening
pillars.line: Dual elements on the 4 and 6 kW models deliver up to 6 kW of directional warmth, and the Affinity Smart-Heat® Dimmer lets you turn it up on a cold night and down on a mild one.
proof: Affinity Smart-Heat® Dimmer as standard recommendation

pillars.title: Mounts Wherever The Evening Happens
pillars.line: Flat ceiling, pitched ceiling, wall or extended wall bracket, angled up to 45° and re-angled later, or recessed flush in a low-clearance ceiling: one heater for every setting.

pillars.title: Safe, Dual Fan-Ventilated 6 kW Recessing
pillars.line: Tungsten Series II is the only 6 kW recessed outdoor heater with a dual fan-ventilated, low-clearance recess kit: built for extended evenings of use in a 7.5 in ceiling cavity, with no site-built fire-rated box, and the Bromic app switches it off remotely, on a timer or at a set time each night.
proof: The only 6 kW recess kit found that is dual fan-ventilated and needs no site-built fire-rated box
No box to build: the kit is the recess
No cool-down advice after continuous use
pillars.verify: [[VERIFY: that the low-clearance kit needs no fire-rated lining or enclosure under its listing, and that 7.5 in is the cavity depth — Product team; competitor check signed off — Specification and compliance]]

pillars.title: Effortless To Install
pillars.line: A single post replaces the two-post mounts of Tungsten Series I, and recessing needs no box built on site: one low-clearance kit serves Select and Coastal. Fewer parts, fewer trades, faster installs.
proof: Single-post mount (Series I: two suspension tubes)
Recessing with no box to build on site
One low-clearance kit across Select and Coastal

pillars.title: Visually Cleaner, Seemingly Floating
pillars.line: About 14% narrower and 10% shallower than Series I, a section 23% smaller, and on its single post the heater appears to float, with no visible junction box.
proof: 14% narrower, 10% shallower, 23% smaller section (183 × 140 mm against 214 × 156 mm)

pillars.title: All Black, All White, All Graphite
pillars.line: Each finish covers the whole heater, so Tungsten sits beautifully against timber and plaster ceilings, with a Diamond, oval or star fascia over the elements.
proof: Full-body finishes: black, white, graphite (graphite on 4 and 6 kW)
3 fascias: Diamond standard, oval and star sold separately
Made to sit against timber ceilings

pillars.title: Built For Life By The Water
pillars.line: Tungsten Coastal protects against corrosion twice over: 316 marine-grade stainless steel, finished with a protective coating, with a marine-grade low-clearance recess kit to match.
pillars.verify: [[VERIFY: name and specification of the Coastal coating — Product team]]

pillars.title: One Family For Every Outdoor Room
pillars.line: The right Bromic heater for every use: electric on ceilings, walls, posts and recesses; the Eclipse pendant; Eclipse Freestanding electric; built-in gas; and Tungsten Freestanding Gas, with Affinity-controlled heaters on the Bromic app.
proof: Design-forward California room: Platinum Smart-Heat® Electric
Open seating away from walls: Tungsten Smart-Heat® Freestanding Gas
pillars.verify: [[VERIFY: app control for Tungsten Freestanding Gas and Eclipse Freestanding — Product team]]

claim_checks.claim: The only 6 kW low-clearance recess option on the market
claim_checks.why: Infratech WD-6024, Lynx LEH61 and Eurofase EF60 (all 6,000 W) are approved for flush recessing with minimum 2×8 framing (about 7.25 in), shallower than 7.5 in. Solaira ICR H3 (6,000 W) needs a fire-rated enclosure at least 9.25 in deep.
claim_checks.use_instead: The only 6 kW recessed outdoor heater with a dual fan-ventilated, low-clearance recess kit, with no site-built fire-rated box needed.
claim_checks.safest: Recess 6,000 W into a 7.5 in ceiling cavity: the kit is dual fan-ventilated, so there is no site-built box.
open: Low-clearance kit listing: no fire-rated lining or enclosure, and 7.5 in is the cavity depth (Product team)
Actual minimum cavity depth for an Infratech WD-6024 flush install (Specification and compliance, ask Infratech)
Eurofase fire-rated box depth from Eurofase documents (retail listing says 7.25 in)
Heatscope, Heatstrip, Schwank, Tansun, Calcana, Dimplex, Burda, Solamagic and others: confirm no 6 kW recess product

slimness.note: From the launch deck (width × depth). Section = width × depth: 33,384 mm² to 25,620 mm². [[VERIFY: Series I dimensions differ between the deck (214 × 156 mm) and the manual (8.5 × 3.5 in) — Product team]]
